experiment: E2: graded-query readout of stored winner sets

bootstrap.index: numpy.random.default_rng(0).integers(0, n, (2000, n)), one per trial count

a_glove.rule: trial-bootstrap 95% lower bound of AP(fly asym)/AP(best competitor) >= 1.0 for >= 4 of 5 k

b_mnist.rule: trial-bootstrap 95% lower bound >= 1.0 at k = 2 and at k = 4

c_connectome.rule: all 4 gaps (connectome-null, even_fanout-null; k = 4, 16) of a dataset: asymmetric point estimate inside the symmetric 95% interval; pass on >= 3 of 4 datasets
